cards.ex: He was a larger than life character, always telling jokes and making people laugh.
cards.exUz: U doim hazillar aytib, odamlarni kuldiradigan, balandparvoz odam edi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamdan ko'ra kattaroq, kuchliroq yoki muhimroq ko'rinadigan.

cards.ex: The new bridge will span a distance of considerable length.
cards.exUz: Yangi ko'prik ancha uzun masofani qamrab oladi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq muddat yoki masofaga ega bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The sweater shrunk in size after I washed it.
cards.exUz: Jumperni yuvganimdan keyin hajmi kichrayib ketdi.

cards.ex: The picture wasn't hanging squarely on the wall.
cards.exUz: Rasm devorda to'ppa-tog'ri osilmagan edi.
cards.uzDef: To'rtburchak shaklida yoki to'g'ri burchak ostida.

cards.ex: There's ample room in the trunk for all our luggage.
cards.exUz: Bagaj uchun magistralda keng joy bor.

cards.ex: The walls in this apartment are paper-thin.
cards.exUz: Bu xonadondagi devorlar qog'ozdek yupqa.

cards.ex: The road had a rough patch after the storm.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron keyin yo'lning bir qismi notekis edi.

cards.ex: The river is of considerable width at this point.
cards.exUz: Daryo bu nuqtada ancha keng.

cards.ex: The road will taper off into a dirt track.
cards.exUz: Yo'l asta-sekin tuproqli izga aylanadi.

cards.ex: We drove across a vast expanse of desert.
cards.exUz: Biz keng cho'lni kesib o'tdik.

cards.ex: The smaller shops are on the periphery of the city center.
cards.exUz: Kichik do'konlar shahar markazining chetida joylashgan.

cards.ex: There is a deep-seated resentment in the community.
cards.exUz: Jamiyatda chuqur ildiz otgan norozilik bor.

cards.ex: I tried to get the measure of the new boss during the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuv davomida yangi boshliqni baholashga harakat qildim.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir yoki nimadir haqida tushunchaga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The police are searching in the vicinity of the park.
cards.exUz: Politsiya parkning atrofida qidiruv olib bormoqda.

cards.ex: This computer cost a fraction of what I paid for my last one.
cards.exUz: Bu kompyuter oldingi kompyuterimga to'lagan pulning bir qismiga teng.

cards.ex: He took a roundabout way to explain the problem.
cards.exUz: U muammoni tushuntirish uchun aylana yo'lni tanladi.

cards.ex: The project is of limited scope and will only focus on one area.
cards.exUz: Loyiha cheklangan doirada bo'lib, faqat bir sohaga e'tibor qaratadi.

cards.ex: He tends to stretch the truth when he tells stories.
cards.exUz: U hikoyalar aytganda yolg'on aralashtirishga moyil.

cards.ex: He gave us a broad outline of his plans for the company.
cards.exUz: U bizga kompaniya uchun rejalarining umumiy ko'rinishini berdi.

cards.ex: The population growth is expected to level off in the next decade.
cards.exUz: Aholi o'sishi keyingi o'n yillikda tekislanishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'sish yoki kamayishni to'xtatib, tekis bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Only a tiny fraction of the students passed the exam.
cards.exUz: Faqat talabalarning juda kichik qismi imtihondan o'tdi.

cards.ex: Her criticism was thinly veiled, but we all knew what she meant.
cards.exUz: Uning tanqidi yashiringan edi, lekin hammamiz nimani nazarda tutganini bilardik.

cards.ex: The party got a little out of hand last night.
cards.exUz: Kechagi ziyofat biroz nazoratdan chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Nazorat ostidan chiqib ketmoq, boshqarib bo'lmaydigan bo'lib qolmoq.

cards.ex: He cut a fine figure in his new suit.
cards.exUz: U yangi kostyumida go'zal ko'rindi.
cards.uzDef: Jozibali va yaxshi ko'rinishga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The houses are built in close proximity to each other.
cards.exUz: Uylar bir-biriga yaqin masofada qurilgan.

cards.ex: The room is of average dimensions, neither too big nor too small.
cards.exUz: Xona o'rtacha o'lchamga ega, juda katta ham, juda kichik ham emas.

cards.ex: He started the business on a small scale from his garage.
cards.exUz: U biznesni garajidan kichik hajmda boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik miqyosda yoki kichik hajmda amalga oshiriladigan.

cards.ex: The news of the event spread far and wide.
cards.exUz: Voqea haqidagi xabar keng tarqaldi.

cards.ex: The company needs room to maneuver in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaga muzokaralarda harakat erkinligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni o'zgartirish yoki yaxshilash uchun imkoniyat.

cards.ex: He was slightly built, but surprisingly strong.
cards.exUz: U ozodgina edi, lekin hayratlanarli darajada kuchli.
